scope: All zones; all 8 P/LAI -> ET/T/E_veg/E_soil pairs; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS
main_metrics: log-log slope, intercept, r, r2, p_value, stderr; MIC
formula_notes: loglog: linear regression on log-transformed raw x/y; MIC from MINE on raw scatter.
difference_from_current: Not fitted-curve Shape/Strength/Tightness. Correlations/dependence are raw-scatter based, not curve-coordinate based.

scope: HW only; P/LAI -> T/E_soil; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS
main_metrics: gam_r2, pseudo_r2, edf, r2, rmse, mae, residual_variance, fitted_range
formula_notes: Residual metrics use y_raw - y_pred for a specific method such as LOWESS/GAM/saturation curvefit.
difference_from_current: Current Tightness generalizes residual metrics to all seven methods and all requested HW T + all-zone E_soil relations; old files are method-specific and HW-only.

scope: HW only; P/LAI -> T/E_soil; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS
main_metrics: fitted_range, mean_abs_slope, max_abs_slope, head_slope, mid_slope, tail_slope, slope_drop, saturation_index
formula_notes: saturation_index = 1 - tail_mean_abs_slope / head_mean_abs_slope; slopes often use raw x or x-scaled-only variants depending on file.
difference_from_current: Current slope metrics use both normalized x and normalized fitted y. Old scaledx files normalize x only, so slope magnitudes are in raw y units per normalized x.

scope: HW only; P/LAI -> T/E_soil; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS
main_metrics: s_early, s_late, r_early, r_late, saturation_ratio, head_slope, mid_slope, tail_slope
formula_notes: Two-segment uses median x split and linregress per half. Three-segment uses x quantiles and edge median slopes.
difference_from_current: Current early/middle/late slopes are computed from fitted curve local slopes over normalized x thirds, not raw-scatter segment regressions.

scope: HW only; P/LAI -> T/E_soil; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS
main_metrics: mean_buffer_abs, median_buffer_abs, max_buffer_abs, head_mean_buffer_abs, tail_mean_buffer_abs, mean_buffer_rel, tail_buffer_rel
formula_notes: buffer_abs = q95(y in bin) - q05(y in bin); buffer_rel = buffer_abs / abs(y_median).
difference_from_current: Current buffer widths are residual-based around fitted curves. Old buffer metrics are raw y spread within x bins.

scope: HW only; P/LAI -> T/E_soil; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS; LOWESS + binned methods
main_metrics: pearson_r, spearman_rho, form_label, curvature_label, net_change, fitted_range, mean_abs_slope, max_abs_slope, saturation_index
formula_notes: correlations are raw-scatter; curve style is rule-based from LOWESS/binned curve slope/curvature diagnostics.
difference_from_current: Current Pearson/Spearman/Kendall are computed on fitted curve coordinates. Current shape_label has a different rule set and more method coverage.

scope: HW T only; P/LAI -> T; CLASSIC and LPJ-GUESS; seven methods
main_metrics: fit_rmse, fit_nrmse, fit_r2, amplitude_raw, amplitude_norm, net_change_norm_by_sd, monotonicity_strength, mean_slope, pos_fraction, neg_fraction, flat_fraction, slope_trend, early/middle/late/terminal slopes, roughness_ratio, valley_depth, peak_height
formula_notes: Most slope descriptors use min-max normalized fitted x/y. Strength normalizers include observed y SD and common y SD. Terminal segment is explicitly tracked.
difference_from_current: Closest predecessor to current metrics, but only HW T. Current expands to all-zone E_soil and separates Shape/Strength/Tightness; it drops terminal descriptors and adds Kendall, formal-test placeholders, residual local buffers, and elasticity summaries.

main_metrics: amplitude_raw, amplitude_norm, amplitude_common_norm, amplitude_robust, amplitude_robust_norm, amplitude_robust_common_norm, medians/IQR/means/SD/CV across methods
formula_notes: amplitude_norm = fitted amplitude / relation y_obs_sd; amplitude_common_norm = fitted amplitude / common_y_sd; robust amplitude uses trimmed/robust curve range.
difference_from_current: Current now includes amplitude_norm_by_y_sd, which is comparable to the old SD-normalized amplitude idea, plus amplitude_norm_by_y_range. Older robust/common-SD amplitude consensus metrics are still not reproduced in the current table.

main_metrics: direction_descriptor, marginal_response_descriptor, terminal_descriptor, irregularity_descriptor, strength_descriptor, normalized_response_strength, PC1, PC2
formula_notes: Rule-based descriptors derived from slope fractions, slope ratios, terminal behavior, roughness, extrema, and normalized response strength.
difference_from_current: Current only has one derived shape_label. It does not reproduce the older multi-descriptor text taxonomy or PCA atlas.

scope: HW T only; seven methods for slope accumulation; equal-width/equal-count bins for certainty
main_metrics: bin_buffer90_by_sd, bin_data_certainty_score90, endpoint_certainty_score90, cumulative_absolute_change, slope_accumulation_ratio, net_to_amplitude_ratio, path_to_amplitude_ratio
formula_notes: Old cumulative curve uses cumulative sum of abs(dy) after x/y normalization; bin certainty uses raw within-bin q95-q05 divided by y SD.
difference_from_current: Current accumulated_slope follows the prompt and uses cumulative sum of abs(local slope). Current tightness buffers are residual-based, not within-bin raw spread.
